summary: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to establish a 30% investment tax credit for "hydropower improvement property" placed in service before 2032, covering upgrades to existing hydroelectric dams for purposes such as fish passage, water quality, dam safety, and removal of obsolete river obstructions, and allows for direct payment or transfer of this credit.

scores.thoughts: This bill introduces a new tax credit, which reduces government revenue and can be considered a form of indirect government spending or subsidy. The credit is for 30% of the basis of hydropower improvement property.

The bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to create a new tax credit for maintaining and enhancing hydroelectric facilities. This credit would reduce the tax liability for eligible entities, effectively lowering their taxes.
